encoding: uint16-le, row 0 = north, elev = elevMin + v/65535*(elevMax-elevMin)
source: 30-m HRSC DTM Mosaic of Gale Crater (Persaud et al. 2021)
citation: Persaud, D.M., Putri, A.D.R., Muller, J.-P., 2021, Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.5808354.
method: Cropped from the prepared 100 m grid in public/data/terrain/crater (itself read from the source DEM) and quantised to 16 bits.
limitations: Grid spacing is 100 m, so nothing smaller than that is represented.
No no-data cells in this window.
Quantisation step is 0.083 m over a 5437 m range.
region: Aeolis Palus and the northern flank of Aeolis Mons
